name: Michael Kiss
headline: CEO @ Symmetry Commerce | Shopify Enterprise & B2B Partner | ex-Shopify Professional Services Leader
about:
I build and scale commerce systems where complexity is the norm. B2B, DTC and enterprise with one focus: make buying simpler and operations smoother.

 

Today, I’m the CEO & Co-Founder at Symmetry Commerce, a Shopify Partner helping brands modernize how they sell online. We bring strategy + delivery together across storefronts, platform architecture, integrations, and product data, so teams can move faster without sacrificing reliability.

 

Before Symmetry, I spent 8+ years at Shopify, most recently as Sr. Lead Architecture in Professional Services, leading leaders on a global team spanning solutions consulting, platform solutions, delivery, and business analysis. We helped enterprise merchants maximize value from Shopify through site optimization, custom integrations, and complex builds that pushed the platform forward.

 

Highlights from my work:

 

- Led teams delivering solutions for some of the world’s largest commerce brands

- Helped rebuild a $2B/year ecommerce storefront

- Enhance the operations for a merchant portfolio processing over $5B in revenue per year

- Designed a system supporting ~70% of Canadian cannabis ecommerce transactions

 

If you’re building B2B/DTC/wholesale on Shopify, modernizing product data, or untangling ERP/PIM/WMS integrations, I’m always up for a conversation.
… more
